definitions.explanation: A numerical proportion or relationship between two quantities; often used as a suffix for specific rates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失業|しつぎょう}→失業：03179_shitsugyou⟧{率|りつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧{率|りつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧{率|りつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：00546_ageru⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To think of ways to increase the success rate.

notes:
USAGE: {率|りつ} is commonly used as a suffix attached to nouns to indicate a rate or ratio.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{失業|しつぎょう}→失業：03179_shitsugyou⟧{率|りつ} (unemployment rate)
- ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧{率|りつ} (pass rate)
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧{率|りつ} (success rate)
- ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧{率|りつ} (attendance rate)
- ⟦{確率|かくりつ}→確率：00159_kakuritsu⟧ (probability)
- ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧ (efficiency)
- ⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧ (ratio)

NOTE: When used alone as a noun, {率|りつ} typically needs context to specify what rate is meant.
